scheme_name: Vasantrao Naik Tanda / Basti Development Scheme
other_conditions: Tanda/Basti must have at least 51 residents belonging to Vimukta Jatis and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT)
Area must lack basic infrastructure amenities such as drinking water, sanitation, or electrification
benefits_summary: Grant up to ₹10 Lakhs based on VJNT population size (₹4 Lakhs for 51‑100 people, ₹6 Lakhs for 101‑150, and ₹10 Lakhs for more than 151).
